ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Personal_ID_Number__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Birth_Date__c)),
DATE( IF( VALUE(MID(Personal_ID_Number__c, 3, 2)) > 12, 2000 + VALUE(MID(Personal_ID_Number__c, 1, 2)), 1900 + VALUE(MID(Personal_ID_Number__c, 1, 2)) ), IF( VALUE(MID(Personal_ID_Number__c, 3, 2)) > 12, VALUE(MID(Personal_ID_Number__c, 3, 2)) - 20, VALUE(MID(Personal_ID_Number__c, 3, 2)) ), VALUE(MID(Personal_ID_Number__c, 5, 2)) ) <> Birth_Date__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Pesel nie zgadza się z datą urodzenia.
